import type {
  AgentToolResult,
  ExtensionAPI,
  ExtensionUIContext,
} from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";

import { defineTool } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
import { Type } from "typebox";

const textResult = (text: string): AgentToolResult<Record<string, never>> => ({
  content: [
    {
      text,
      type: "text",
    },
  ],
  details: {},
});

/** Reserved choice that opens free-text entry, so a caller-supplied `Other`
 * is a free-response trigger rather than a literal answer. */
const CUSTOM_ANSWER_OPTION = "Other";

const askPerson = async (
  params: { readonly options?: readonly string[]; readonly question: string },
  ui: Pick<ExtensionUIContext, "input" | "select">
): Promise<AgentToolResult<Record<string, never>>> => {
  const options = params.options ?? [];
  const answer =
    options.length > 0
      ? await ui.select(
          params.question,
          options.includes(CUSTOM_ANSWER_OPTION)
            ? [...options]
            : [...options, CUSTOM_ANSWER_OPTION]
        )
      : await ui.input(params.question, "Type your answer");
  const resolvedAnswer =
    answer === CUSTOM_ANSWER_OPTION
      ? await ui.input(params.question, "Type your answer")
      : answer;
  return resolvedAnswer === undefined
    ? textResult("The person cancelled the question.")
    : textResult(`The person answered: ${resolvedAnswer}`);
};

const askUserTool = defineTool({
  description:
    "Ask the person a question when their answer is needed to continue. Offer choices when the answer should come from a short fixed list.",
  execute: (...args) => {
    const [_toolCallId, params, _signal, _onUpdate, context] = args;
    return askPerson(params, context.ui);
  },
  label: "Ask User",
  name: "ask_user",
  parameters: Type.Object({
    options: Type.Optional(
      Type.Array(Type.String(), {
        description: "Optional choices the person can select from",
      })
    ),
    question: Type.String({
      description: "The clear, specific question to ask",
    }),
  }),
  promptSnippet:
    "ask_user(question, options?) - Pause and ask the person for input",
});

const register = (pi: ExtensionAPI): void => {
  pi.registerTool(askUserTool);
};

export { askPerson, askUserTool, register };
export default register;
